acceptance_rule: CR2 must improve by >=1% with CI95 lower >0 against the SAME C or R control in BOTH trials. Passing both controls and CI95 lower >=1% are separate stronger diagnostics. Require identical trajectories within CR2/CR/C; validate R against its own codec reference; preserve all samples.
limitation: Fixed synthetic inputs and this configuration only; no long-term convergence claim.
